newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn to issue 2-year Treasury notes at auction.
newsitem.headline: Bonn to issue 2-year Treasury notes at auction.

text.p: The German government will issue two-year Treasury notes at an auction to be set on December 17, and bids are due by 1000 GMT on December 18, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said on Tuesday.
The settlement date on the notes is December 20, and they will be listed on the stock exchange on December 23, the Bundesbank said.
Further details will be released when the auction is set next week.
The volume of the issue will be up to eight billion marks, according to the government's debt issue calendar for the fourth quarter.
